text: Compare the deployment dates 2026/11/21 and 2027/01/04 in the release notes.
The date 2026//11/21 and the ratios 1/2, 3/40 and 999/1000 stay together.
Compare 5.06, 10:59:30, 1,000,000.00 and 12;34 before continuing.
Try /2026 after /draft and /11 after version/11 or archive/11/21/input.
Copy C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe and D:\users\public\readme.txt to the test folder.
Open D:/dev-sandbox/draft-notes/archive4/test-stubs:$PATH and inspect README.md.
Compare \\share\release\report.txt with ./data/1/2026/11/21/latest.json.
Fetch https://example.test/api/v2/releases/2026/11/21?q=foo%20bar#section.
Read file:///C:/Users/example/a-b.txt then check https://a.b:443/x/y?z=9.
The final heading in the release notes should read Ready|steady|go.
Try input||output, inner | pipe, a|/b, a/|b, |next and before| after.
Compare cross-platform, 1-2, print--all, --dry-run and a->b with well-known.
Run tool --date=2026-11-21 --output=release-notes.json --flag value.
Print (one two), [three four] and {five six} then continue with (s)he.
Keep the opener (  with its text and the closer after some text  ] or  }.
Quote "two words", say 'three words', then check a|“quoted words” with care.
Check “  opening quotes”, « guillemets » and the text following ’ punctuation.
Try $word, word%, €:12, a/+b, 12//,+x and 1//)% before moving on.
Check the limits at .55 and .50, including a .word and ( .9 values).
Examples include e.g. file.txt, word:tail, word:9 and Ready!Next?Fine.
Extra   spaces between words | and spaces  before ; / ? ! count at the margin.
A normal name_123 with #hash@user in <name=value> and x^2~y*3 uses ASCII symbols.
Please print `git diff --check` && echo "$PATH" | sort > output.txt.
An oversized piece abcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefgabcdefg ends before the next word.
Check the café menu: crème brûlée costs £5.50 or 6€ today.
An ellipsis… then a nonbreaking‑hyphen and two words stay in the sample.
Unicode hyphens left‐right, left–right and an initial ‐word have different contexts.
Check repeated punctuation alpha— —beta with an isolated alpha—beta.
A mixed sentence with 漢字界“文界”字 and £界 or 界% in it.
